notes.title: Discovery Yard Investigation - New case! - Atualização 07/05/2021
notes.content:
Hello Detectives! The new case is available!

Also some other improvements were made.


Changelog:

Added new case "Case 3 - The case of the sincere suspect"
Added "Notepad" function - Now pressing the "N" key opens a notepad for you to write your own notes.
Fixed lighting effects.
Interaction crosshairs are bigger.

notes.title: BRUNOARTS Entertainment
notes.content:
Hello detectives and future detectives!

To celebrate Halloween BRUNOARTS Entertainment brought some news for you.


We are working on a new game! The new game will share Discovery Yard Investigation scenarios and new scenarios developed for the new game will also go to Discovery Yard Investigation.

Discovery Yard Police will be the name of the new game! A multiplayer and this time the players will be a tactical team. And the team must make the right decisions to fulfill its objectives, the secret will be cooperation. Soon we will present more information about him.


Discovery Yard Investigation will continue to grow together! We're creating really cool things for him! we just ask for a little patience, we like to do our best always and a good mystery has to be well written.


For the future, BRUNOARTS Entertainment also plans to create a "Point and Click" project but one thing at a time.

Once again we thank all players for their support! We are always attentive to your suggestions.

Thanks
BRUNOARTS Entertainment

notes.title: BRUNOARTS Wish you all a Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
Hello Detectives! and future detectives who are considering buying the game. We want to wish everyone a happy halloween! Enjoy the promotions!


We also want to communicate that on 10/31 (Halloween) we will publish some news! We will talk about our future plans and announce a new project! That will work in conjunction with Discovery Yard Investigation.


Once again we thank you all! And we wait for you in the Discovery Yard universe.


BRUNOARTS Entertainment

notes.title: Discovery Yard Investigation - Update 10/04/2020
notes.content:
Hello Detectives!

We are working to make the game always better!

This update resolved some bugs reported by players.


Changelog:

MotionBlur: It is temporarily disabled (soon we will put the option to activate and deactivate).

ButtonRead: We removed this option to avoid the "FullHealth" bug. There is now an exclusive document talking about the weapons of crime.

English version: Document on weapons of crime has been translated correctly.



Soon we will be providing a more detailed manual regarding all commands and with tips on how to solve the mysteries.

In the discussion forum we will create a topic explaining how you can better report any errors you find. Some players talk about passwords that do not work and it is very difficult for us to know what mystery it is about since 4 random mysteries are drawn.

We ask for patience. We are just a team of 1 person rsss and we are working on a second project that soon we will talk more about it for you.

Thank you all!
BRUNOARTS Entertainment

notes.title: Hello Detectives.
notes.content:
Hello Detectives.

We apologize to the players for any bugs. We are always attentive to the bugs reported by you and we analyze. We are also always attentive to requests to improve the game's performance. We ask for patience.

Thank you all!
